text: 10 Meet my family. 1.7 1. Listen and enact. Harsh is visiting Priya’s house. Hello Priya! Meet my mother. Namaste Aaji and Ajoba! Namaste Harsh! God bless you. Meet my Aaji and Ajoba. Meet my father. Hello Harsh! Welcome home. Hello Kaki! Hello Kaka! Hello! Nice to meet you, Harsh. What will you say if elders say ‘Thank you’ to you?  You are welcome.  It’s my pleasure. What will you say if your friend says ‘Thank you’ to you?  You are welcome.  It’s my pleasure. Do you know? • The names of your family members. 2. Tick  the correct options.
